faq.q1: Who is required to pay SME tax?
faq.a1: All SMEs registered as Taxpayers with annual turnover under IDR 4.8 billion. If you do not have a Tax ID (NPWP) yet, register at the nearest tax office or via pajak.go.id.
faq.q2: What is the SME Final Income Tax rate?
faq.a2: The Final Income Tax rate for SMEs is 0.5% of monthly gross turnover. Paid no later than the 15th of the following month.
faq.q3: Do I need to file an Annual Tax Return?
faq.a3: Yes, even if you pay monthly Final Income Tax, you must still file an Annual Individual Income Tax Return each year (no later than March 31).
faq.q4: How do I register for a business Tax ID (NPWP)?
faq.a4: You can register online via pajak.go.id or visit the nearest Tax Office (KPP) in person. Prepare your ID card (KTP), Family Card (KK), and business documents.
faq.q5: Are there tax incentives for SMEs?
faq.a5: Yes! The government provides a 0.5% Final Income Tax facility for up to 7 years for individual SMEs. Take advantage of this incentive while it applies.

subscription.faq1Q: Can I upgrade or downgrade anytime?
subscription.faq1A: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes apply in the next billing period.
subscription.faq2A: We accept bank transfers, credit/debit cards, and digital wallets (GoPay, OVO, DANA).
subscription.faq3Q: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
subscription.faq3A: The Free plan can be used forever at no cost. You can upgrade anytime as your business expands.
